regions.today: Cloudier than previous days, starting off mostly dry before patchy outbreaks of rain develop through the morning. The rain will turn more persistent in the evening. Cooler too with highest temperatures of 18 to 22 degrees, with moderate to fresh south to southwest winds easing through the day.
regions.tonight: Starting off cloudy with any remaining outbreaks of rain clearing the east coast, before clear spells develop from the west with just the odd shower. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 14 degrees, mildest in the east, with light to moderate southwesterly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Sunny spells with just a few showers in the west and north of the province. Cooler again, with highest temperatures of16 to 20 degrees, with moderate to fresh southwesterly winds, easing later in the day.
